DEVASTATE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {StarGain}.
On kill, this card permanently gains 1 additional Star for this run.
GENESIS.description:
Cards you play this turn do not consume {singleStarIcon}.
At the end of this turn, lose all {singleStarIcon}. You cannot gain {singleStarIcon} for the rest of combat.
GAMMA_BLAST.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Colorless cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
For each card Exhausted, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
FURNACE.description:
At the start of your turn, [gold]Forge[/gold] {Forge:diff()}.{IfUpgraded:show:
At the start of combat, play this card automatically.}
FOREGONE_CONCLUSION.title: Fated Victory
FOREGONE_CONCLUSION.description: Gain [gold]Strength[/gold] equal to your [gold]Vigor[/gold], then lose all [gold]Vigor[/gold].
GLOW.description:
Gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Next turn, draw 1 card.
MYSTS2CONTENTMOD-POWER_THROUGH.title: Power Through
SILENTREBALANCE-CONCENTRATE.title: Concentrate
CALCULATED_GAMBLE.description:
Discard your [gold]Hand[/gold],
then draw that many cards.
CORROSIVE_WAVE.description: Whenever you draw a card this turn, apply {CorrosiveWave:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to a random enemy.
MASTER_PLANNER.description: Each turn, the first non-[gold]Sly[/gold] Skill you play gains [gold]Sly[/gold].
WRAITH_FORM.description:
Gain {IntangiblePower:diff()} [gold]Intangible[/gold].
At the start of your turn, lose {WraithFormPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
CONSUMING_SHADOW.title: Consuming Shadow
CONSUMING_SHADOW.description: Whenever you Evoke a [gold]Dark Orb[/gold], gain Block equal to {IfUpgraded:show:100%|50%} of the unblocked damage dealt.
COOLANT.title: Coolant
COOLANT.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Attack[/gold] card, channel a temporary [gold]Frost Orb[/gold] that disappears at the start of your turn.
DARKNESS.title: Darkness
DARKNESS.description:
Channel a [gold]Dark Orb[/gold].
Trigger all [gold]Dark Orbs[/gold]' passive 1 time.
FUEL.title: Fuel
GLASSWORK.title: Glasswork
HOTFIX.title: Hotfix
HOTFIX.description:
Gain {FocusPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Focus[/gold].
Each time you play this card, its [gold]cost[/gold] increases by 1 this turn.
ICE_LANCE.title: Ice Lance
ICE_LANCE.description:
Evoke all [gold]Frost Orbs[/gold].
For each [gold]Frost Orb[/gold] evoked, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
LIGHTNING_ROD.title: Lightning Rod
LIGHTNING_ROD.description:
Evoke all [gold]Lightning Orbs[/gold].
For each [gold]Lightning Orb[/gold] evoked, gain {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
MODDED.title: Modded
MODDED.description:
Gain 1 [gold]Orb[/gold] slot.
Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
After playing, this card's [gold]cost[/gold] increases by 1 this turn.
REFRACT.title: Refract
REFRACT.description:
When you are about to take damage, evoke a [gold]Glass Orb[/gold] with a counter greater than 0 and prevent this damage.{IfUpgraded:show:
On play, channel 1 [gold]Glass Orb[/gold].}
SCAVENGE.title: Recycle
SCAVENGE.description: Exhaust a card. Gain energy equal to its energy cost.
DEFECTREBALANCE-RECURSION.title: Recursion
DEFECTREBALANCE-RECURSION.description: Evoke your [gold]rightmost[/gold] orb, then channel an orb identical to the one evoked.
DEFECTREBALANCE-HEAT_SINKS.title: Heat Sinks
DEFECTREBALANCE-HEAT_SINKS.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Power[/gold] card, draw {HeatSinksPower:diff()} card(s).
